$comment: Tenant record — created by integrations/hosted-verify/pilot/tenant.sh add as $HOME/.bolyra/tenants-<env>/<org_id>.json (off the git checkout; <env> = production or staging); fill in the human fields by hand. This file IS the tenant registry, read by tenant.sh sync and by humans. NO secrets in this file, ever: the two tokens live in the macOS keychain (service bolyra-hosted-verify, accounts tenant-<org_id>-admin / -verifier) and reach the Worker only through the TENANTS secret.
$status_values: active (entry live in TENANTS) | disabled (entry kept with "disabled": true — served on no route: /v1/verify answers 500 internal_error, the registry routes 503 tenant_disabled; the partner cannot tell the 500 from a defect, so tell them) | removed (tokens deleted, entry dropped from TENANTS; this file and the tenant's Durable Object with its credential history are kept)
$trustedOperators_note: The tenant's BabyJubjub operator public key(s) as x:y decimal pairs — tenant.sh sync writes exactly this list into the tenant's trusted_operators. The second entry is the repo conformance fixture key that `add --with-fixture-key` seeds (preview-only; edit it out and re-sync once the tenant's own key has passed the smoke test). Trust is necessary, not sufficient: an allow also needs the signed binding registered under this tenant and not revoked.

tierCaps.$note: @bolyra/mpp financial tiers over the SDK's cumulative permission bits: small < $100, medium < $10,000 (implies small), unlimited (implies both). Enforced by the credential's permission bitmask + the capability map — this field is the agreed pilot cap, recorded for the humans.
